commonPatterns.recommendation: Create ErrorMapper utility in BaseRouteHandler with predefined error code to HTTP status mappings
Standardize error response format through BaseRouteHandler errorResponse method
Create handleServiceResult utility that automatically maps Result<T> to HTTP responses
Automatically add timestamps in BaseRouteHandler success responses
Create middleware composition helpers in BaseRouteHandler for common auth patterns

commonPatterns.pattern: CSV export with manual header/row formatting
commonPatterns.recommendation: Extract CSV generation to shared utility with proper escaping
Standardize pagination response structure in BaseRouteHandler

requiredEnhancements.reason: providerOAuth.ts and webhookHandler.ts have unique OAuth flow error patterns across 5+ providers
requiredEnhancements.details: Need provider-specific error mappers for token exchange, refresh, signature verification failures

requiredEnhancements.reason: 134 occurrences of manual .ok checking with error mapping across all service-layer interactions
requiredEnhancements.details: Automatic conversion of Result.success/failure to appropriate HTTP responses with consistent error format

requiredEnhancements.reason: 67 manual try-catch blocks for Zod parsing, inconsistent error messages
requiredEnhancements.details: validateBody, validateQuery, validateParams methods with automatic 400 responses and formatted errors

requiredEnhancements.reason: webhookHandler has different signature verification per provider
requiredEnhancements.details: Webhook signature verification helpers for each provider (HMAC-SHA256, custom headers, etc.)

requiredEnhancements.reason: 5 different CSV implementations with varying escape logic
requiredEnhancements.details: Shared CSV generator with proper RFC 4180 compliance and type-safe column definitions

requiredEnhancements.reason: 12 different pagination implementations with inconsistent response formats
requiredEnhancements.details: Standardized pagination with hasNext, hasPrev, totalPages calculations

requiredEnhancements.reason: Multiple implementations of time range parsing ('1h', '24h', '7d') with different logic
requiredEnhancements.details: Consistent time range parsing with validation

requiredEnhancements.reason: webhookDashboardRoutes has SSE implementation that could be reused
requiredEnhancements.details: Reusable SSE setup with heartbeat and proper cleanup

priority1_critical_complex.description: Most complex, highest impact, blocking other migrations
priority1_critical_complex.reasoning: OAuth flows are critical infrastructure used by all provider integrations. Webhook system is complex event-driven architecture. Both have many provider-specific error patterns.

priority2_high_value.description: Well-structured files that can serve as migration templates
priority2_high_value.reasoning: These files have good structure with Zod schemas and service layers. Can be migrated in parallel after BaseRouteHandler enhancements are complete.

priority3_mock_or_demo.description: Files with mock data or demo functionality
priority3_mock_or_demo.reasoning: Either have placeholder implementations (analytics, dashboard) or are feature-complete but lower priority (AI, monitoring).

priority4_refactor_needed.description: Files needing significant refactoring before or during migration
priority4_refactor_needed.reasoning: Uses 'any' types extensively, missing authentication, needs complete type safety overhaul.

priority5_supporting.reasoning: Low priority infrastructure. Can be migrated last or kept as-is. fastifyPatterns.ts is reference documentation.

tasks: Implement Result<T> to HTTP response mapper
Add Zod validation helpers (validateBody, validateQuery, validateParams)

risks: OAuth flows are in production - zero downtime required
Webhook retry logic must be preserved exactly
mitigationStrategy: Feature flag for new vs old implementation
Comprehensive integration tests with real provider sandboxes

phase3_parallel_migration.approach: Can be done by multiple developers in parallel since they're well-structured

phase4_cleanup.description: Migrate remaining routes and refactor templateRoutes.ts
phase4_cleanup.notes: templateRoutes.ts needs refactoring before migration. Others are straightforward.

high.risk: OAuth flow breakage affecting user authentication
high.mitigation: Feature flags, parallel running, comprehensive testing
Queue-based architecture ensures no events lost, extensive retry testing

medium.risk: Performance regression from additional abstraction layers
Type safety issues from complex generic constraints

low.risk: Breaking changes to error response formats
low.mitigation: Version API responses, maintain backward compatibility

recommendations.recommendation: Start with BaseRouteHandler enhancements (phase 1) before any route migrations
recommendations.reason: All other migrations depend on these utilities. Attempting migration without them will result in rework.

recommendations.recommendation: Migrate providerOAuth.ts and webhookHandler.ts with extreme caution using feature flags
recommendations.reason: These are production-critical systems handling authentication and real-time events. Zero downtime is mandatory.

recommendations.recommendation: Use accountLifecycleRoutes.ts and auditRoutes.ts as migration templates
recommendations.reason: These files demonstrate best practices with Zod schemas and proper service layer separation.

recommendations.recommendation: Completely refactor templateRoutes.ts types before migration
recommendations.reason: Current 'any' types throughout will negate benefits of BaseRouteHandler. Fix types first.

recommendations.recommendation: Consolidate CSV export implementations before individual route migrations
recommendations.reason: 5 different implementations exist. Create shared utility to avoid spreading inconsistencies.

recommendations.recommendation: Consider keeping test and documentation routes (priority 5) as-is
recommendations.reason: Low business value for migration. They work fine and demonstrate various patterns.

recommendations.recommendation: Document Zod version differences (v3 vs v4) in migration guide
recommendations.reason: Some files use Zod v4 with different imports. Need consistent approach.
